detail:
Full summary: Recovery-and-rollback operator guide finished (480 lines, 95 commands re-run at 0f9fd985, independently re-executed, two timing claims corrected); final report gained rows for peer events quarantined over the filesystem carrier, identity-init stores duplicated by migrate, and signed native events labelled legacy_unverified by the read path. All five operator docs and the report are now complete; committing and pushing.
Findings: Over sync --path a peer's events stay quarantined signature_required and no verb trusts a peer key, so no CLI carrier delivers records across replicas (recovery guide K6) — exchange works at the byte level only; assemble/why on a v3 store label signed native events legacy_unverified and tell the model they were migrated with no authorship proof (K11) — a wrong trust class on the read path, R03/R17; migrate --to 3 on an identity-init store re-imports the 2.x mirror of each native write as a second legacy_unverified record (K9), then the store is read-only (K1); The real migration of this repo's ~30 MB legacy store took 13–17 minutes in two runs and did not finalize; the writer's first 73-minute figure was contention, not the code
